description: Source code for VerticalYAxisRenderer class, part of PDFsharp library, responsible for rendering and formatting the vertical Y axis in charts such as Column2D or Line charts.

classes.name: VerticalYAxisRenderer
classes.description: A renderer class for drawing and formatting the Y axis in charts, including tick marks, labels, and axis title.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes renderer info based on the chart's Y axis, including scale, tick labels, axis title, and gridlines.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Calculates the space needed for the Y axis, including labels, tick marks, and title.

methods.name: Draw
methods.description: Draws the Y axis, tick marks, labels, and title on the graphics context.

methods.name: InitScale
methods.description: Calculates min/max scale and tick intervals for the Y axis.

methods.name: GetTickMarkPos
methods.description: Determines the start and end positions for major and minor tick marks based on tick mark type.

methods.name: CalcYAxis
methods.description: Calculates the minimum and maximum Y values from all series in the chart.
